code:
cd /workspace
git config user.name "Your Name"
git config user.email "you@example.com"
description: Configure git user name and email per repository so they persist in the workspace mount across container sessions.

steps.description: Three commands to set git identity in the workspace.
Directory: cd /workspace moves to the mounted repository.
Name: git config user.name sets your name per repository.
Email: git config user.email sets your email per repository, stored in /workspace/.git/config.

title: Set Git Identity in Container
